posts.subject: [ENG] Interview with Nachtfrische + warm words.
posts.bodyHtml:
First of all I would like to incredibly thank @Nachtfrische for letting me conduct this interview, without him agreeing this post would have not happened.


I'm creating this thread for the community to see and get a little feeling of the work as a Co-Leader and what the leadership is dealing with, It started with just a normal conversation but later turned into something I have not expected.


I have conducted this interview as on the date 25/09/2017 will be the whole year Nacht was a co-leader so I though maybe it's time to ask him how he feels about it and his personal view on some stuff in dream, not wasting anymore time let's move onto the interview.


01:23 - Dominus Vobiscum: Anyway it's soon a year since you became a co-leader
01:25 - Nachtfrische: Yup
01:26 - Dominus Vobiscum: I'ma say a early congratz and how did you feel through the year as high rank person with me being in and out of team
01:29 - Nachtfrische: Tbh, its been a lot of work, I'm not sure how much has paid off though
01:30 - Dominus Vobiscum: Do you feel like the community is going in the right direction?
01:31 - Nachtfrische: Nah, actually not
01:35 - Dominus Vobiscum: Why do you think the community took a wrong turn?
01:36 - Nachtfrische: I can't tell, if i could, it wouldn't be that way
01:36 - Nachtfrische: I'm not saying that the community is bad
01:36 - Nachtfrische: It's not, its great
01:37 - Nachtfrische: But in the last months, I've been noticing a more hostile atmosphere
01:37 - Dominus Vobiscum: I wanted to ask you this question,
01:37 - Dominus Vobiscum: How do you feel about the recent weeks where people ask to be banned or players insulting in shoutbox
01:38 - Nachtfrische: I just don't get it
01:39 - Nachtfrische: If they are unhappy, they should tell us what is making them feel this way and maybe we can fix it
01:39 - Nachtfrische: Instead they behave like children, insulting others, disliking every post, causing drama etc
01:40 - Dominus Vobiscum: Coming onto the all drama, how do you feel about disputes that could be happening between some admins?
01:40 - Dominus Vobiscum: As we can't hide it some admins dislike eachother.
01:41 - Nachtfrische: That is up to them, they can like or dislike whoever they want but they should behave neutral and professional towards the public
01:42 - Nachtfrische: And not causing further drama by taunting or teasing each other
01:44 - Dominus Vobiscum: Also some people are complaining about not enough updates/ dream news are happening in the recent times, what do you feel about this?
01:45 - Nachtfrische: I kinda agree with that.
01:46 - Nachtfrische: Dream News are only admin related, so we can't really force that
01:46 - Nachtfrische: Changelog Updates are only getting posted, if its something major or if a lot of changes have been made
01:46 - Nachtfrische: We are silently updating, fixing bugs and adding new features
01:46 - Nachtfrische: As you can see with that First Person Death plugin
01:47 - Nachtfrische: However, not everything is worth mentioning in a new forum post
01:47 - Nachtfrische: Also, there is only so many plugins or maps we can add. You'll eventually reach a point where you can't really improve the server
01:48 - Nachtfrische: Like TTT, what can we improve besides adding new maps? And even then, if we have all the maps, what should we do then?
01:48 - Nachtfrische: Making updates just for the sake of it can be harmful
01:48 - Nachtfrische: But yeah, more changes are going to come in the future
01:49 - Dominus Vobiscum: This seems very promising towards Dream and the overall position it's standing at.
01:49 - Dominus Vobiscum: Recently the dislike button has been added again, what is your opinion about it and the whole abuse part of it?
01:55 - Nachtfrische: I am against the dislike button as I have been the one who originally has pushed for the removal of it. Some people are abusing it, however, we are going to punish those people in the future and will probably add another forum rule against dislike abuse. In my opinion though, it should be removed again but unfortunately, that is not for me to decide.
02:02 - Dominus Vobiscum: How do you feel with the position you're standing at dream atm? The amout of work you put in and the expected level that people want from you, it get's kinda stressfull I guess.
02:03 - Nachtfrische: Well, people message me every day, either something is broken, they have a request or they want to complain about something / someone
02:04 - Nachtfrische: I put as much time into it as I can, although it gets kinda stressful at times. It also depends on my motiviation, sometimes I stay up until 5 or 6am in the morning, because I've been working the whole night at something for Dream
02:05 - Nachtfrische: On other days, usually the day after I worked hard, I don't feel like repeating the same thing and working voluntarily full time for Dream, so my motivation goes down and I neglect some things
02:06 - Nachtfrische: On my position as a Co-Leader, I'm pretty fine with it. There isn't much I could do as a Leader and we already have BlackFire as someone who is more than competent for this position
02:06 - Nachtfrische: (*I could do as a Leader that I couldn't do as a Co-Leader)
02:07 - Nachtfrische: Sky, BlackFire and me usually talk about major changes we are trying to make, so that is pretty important for me
02:07 - Nachtfrische: To get heard
02:09 - Nachtfrische: It is very demoralizing if you been working 8 or 9 hours in a day or even more on something and then people just bash it and they hate it
02:10 - Nachtfrische: It would be fine, if people would give me constructive feedback, telling me what they liked, what they didn't liked and what they want improved
02:10 - Nachtfrische: However, it's usually comments like :"wow, thing xy is fucking shit remove that"
02:11 - Nachtfrische: They may be disliking one small aspect of it, which I can change in 10 seconds but instead they hate on the whole thing
02:11 - Nachtfrische: On the other hand, not every update or work I put into Dream is like this
02:12 - Nachtfrische: Most of the time actually, people are liking the updates and they stuff like "Good job Nachtfrische" which obviously makes me happy and keeps me motivated to keep doing this
02:12 - Dominus Vobiscum: I realize it's a late hour and both of us are tired so I'm gonna jump into last 2 questions.
02:14 - Dominus Vobiscum: Is there anything you could do to make this community better like it used to be like a year ago or have any possible way into this?
02:15 - Nachtfrische: It's hard to say, we probably all have a feeling of nostalgia, for you, it's a year ago, I could say, I liked the community better two years ago
02:15 - Nachtfrische: For BlackFire, it might be 3 or 4 years, who knows
02:16 - Nachtfrische: It's always subjective, the best the community has ever been is the best you have started to actively participate in it
02:16 - Nachtfrische: It's the same for everyone, honeymoon period basically
02:17 - Nachtfrische: But to get back to your question, like I said earlier, we are trying to fix stuff and Sky/Black and me want to get together soon to discuss some major changes we are going to make in the upcoming weeks / months
02:17 - Nachtfrische: There are probably going to be some bigger changes as well
02:18 - Dominus Vobiscum: Moving onto the last question before I kill us both of tiredness.
02:19 - Dominus Vobiscum: Do you have anything aginst me stating this little interview on forum with some warm words?
02:20 - Nachtfrische: I was 100% that this question is going to come soon 🙂
02:22 - Nachtfrische: Yeah, you can publish the interview.



Once again I wanna deeply thank @Nachtfrische for letting me conduct this rather smaller "interview" I have learned a lot on how a community Co-Leader and the overall leadership feels and the stress they get, this has opened my eyes a lot.


I wanna congratulate Nacht on the past year as a Co-Leader you have changed the dream incredibly and made a massive impact on the player base with the updates of maps or plugins, I wish you more of constant success and great management without you most of us would not be standing the grounds at Dream that we currently are.


Wishing you Nacht and the leadership more success deeply from my heart.


Sincerely


OxygeN

It's a very interesting interview because I love to see what people think about some questions.


Keep up the hard work @Nachtfrische. [;)]
